Georg Friedrich Heinrich Fürst zu Waldeck und Pyrmont; 20 September 1789 – 15 May 1845) was Prince of 
Waldeck and Pyrmont, ruling from 1813 to 1845. 
Early life and ancestry[edit]Born into the main Pyrmont line of an ancient German 
House of Waldeck, he was the third child and eldest surviving son of 
George I, Prince of Waldeck and Pyrmont and 
Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. 
His mother was third child and second daughter of August II, Prince of 
Schwarzburg-Sondershausen (1738-1806) and 
Princess Christine of Anhalt-Bernburg.
